name: Linear Search
description: Finds the index of a value in the array
code:
# Linear Search (RISC-V assembly)
# Searches for a key in a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# a2 = key to search for
# a3 = result: index of the key, or -1 if not found

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    li a2, 0x5          # key to search for
    li t0, 0x0          # i = 0

loop:
    bge t0, a1, notfound     # i >= n -> the key is not in the array
    slli t1, t0, 0x2         # t1 = i * 4
    add t1, a0, t1           # t1 = &a[i]
    lw  t2, 0x0(t1)          # t2 = a[i]
    beq t2, a2, found        # a[i] == key -> found
    addi t0, t0, 0x1         # i++
    j loop

found:
    mv a3, t0                # a3 = index of the key
    j end

notfound:
    li a3, -1                # a3 = -1 (negative numbers are written in decimal)

end:
